mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sound-sensitive membranes was most worthwhile because the result explained how motion in cochlear fluid changes signals to nerve fibers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the hair cells into the cochleas felt like a predictable intermediate step; the result added little explanation until the membranes were fitted.

surprise.text: The explanation that bending hair-cell bundles changes their signals clarified how vibration becomes information carried by nerves.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary, though most choices were the only offered combination, so the sequence involved little decision-making.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it connected the senses to a new situation, but the mostly predetermined assembly made this chapter feel repetitive.
